source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.7.1, data build 972, released 2026-10-02

data.summary: While this unit's Fire Coordinator model is still on the battlefield, whenever one of its Heavy Weapons Gunner models is **destroyed**, roll a D6. On a 3+, leave that model on the battlefield: once the attacking unit is done attacking, it can shoot, then it is removed.

ability.condition: the Fire Coordinator model is on the battlefield
ability.trigger: a Heavy Weapons Gunner model is destroyed

effect.mayShoot: after the attacker's unit completes its attacks
